problems: The blind guess (toilet plunger) misses the bob. A plunger's bottom is a wide cup, but the drawn bottom is a small, thin, downward-pointing triangle sitting on a wavy line, which reads as a plumb bob. The top bar and long shaft give only a weak plunger resemblance, so the match is poor.
The stone is too small and thin to read as a solid object. Its gold skeleton nearly coincides with the blue outline, so it looks like a sketch rather than a silhouette.

The cord is slanted: it runs from about (323,108) at the hook to the crown at about (305,405). A true plumb line should hang straight down, so the point should sit below the hook's x-coordinate (about x=323), not at x=280.

The point star 65535 at about (280,470) sits left of the crown, so the stone is off-axis. The left shoulder 64408/65936 placement is also uneven: the right shoulder at (341,430) is much higher than the left at (259,463).

Labels collide: 'left end of the hanging bar' overlaps 'right end of the hanging bar', and the crown and shoulder labels are cut off or overlapping the stone. The labels hide the figure's readability.
The wavy ground line runs under the bob and is nearly touching the point, which adds clutter.
The figure is oriented correctly: hook at top, bob pointing down, with the cord vertical in intent.
